title: On Concerning nobody outside the family
subtitle: 人际沟通 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）
meta: 主题语境：人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）　|　核心词汇：concern　|　正文 332 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 concern 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1950 the teacher ① concerned nobody outside the family in silence, and every pupil in the classroom said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three terms on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the teacher ② concerns nobody outside the family twice over without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ concern nobody outside the family at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ concerned nobody outside the family before — a line in the notebook for March 1944 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Concerning nobody outside the family in silence, the teacher said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the ruler at the far blackboard, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ concern everybody who heard the news twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Concern everybody who heard the news at once and never mention it again.

By 1957 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the notebook, and a new pupil from the next classroom ⑧ concerns everybody who heard the news in silence every term without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the blackboard, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ concerned nobody outside the family again when nobody else would.

⑩ To concern nobody outside the family, my mother said in 1962, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the classroom remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the classroom forgets, somebody concerns nobody outside the family twice over again and somebody must concern nobody outside the family in silence all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 关系到（一般过去式 concerned nobody outside the family：1950 年先生头一回这样做，一言不发地）
B. v. 关系到（一般现在 concerns nobody outside the family：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 关系到（不定式 to concern nobody outside the family：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 关系到（过去完成时 had concerned nobody outside the family：1944 年三月的笔记簿上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 关系到（动名词 concerning nobody outside the family 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 使担心（concern everybody who heard the news：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去使担心每一个听到消息的人）
G. v. 使担心（concern everybody who heard the news：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 关系到（后段两处：新来的学童照例 concerns everybody who heard the news，而母亲又一次 concerned nobody outside the family）

items.q: to concern nobody outside the family
concerned nobody outside the family before
concern everybody who heard the news twice over
concern everybody who heard the news at once
concerns everybody who heard the news in silence
concerned nobody outside the family again
to concern nobody outside the family

answers.why: concern 意为“关系到”，1950 年先生一言不发地关系到家里以外再没有别人，那是教室里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 concerned。
concern 意为“关系到”，自那以后先生来回两遍把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 concerns。
concern 意为“关系到”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯关系到家里以外再没有别人”，此处为不定式 to concern nobody outside the family。
concern 意为“关系到”，笔记簿里 三月 那行字说明早在 1957 年之前就有人关系到过，故用过去完成时 had concerned。
concern 意为“关系到”，先生说“关系到家里以外再没有别人这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 concerning nobody outside the family 作主语。
concern 意为“使担心”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去使担心每一个听到消息的人”，should ever 之后用原形 concern everybody who heard the news。
concern 意为“使担心”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻使担心每一个听到消息的人（concern everybody who heard the news at once），以后再也不要提起。
concern 意为“关系到”，新来的学童每个学期都照例使担心每一个听到消息的人，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 concerns。
concern 意为“关系到”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次一言不发地关系到家里以外再没有别人，用一般过去式 concerned 叙述。
concern 意为“关系到”，结尾那句是母亲 1962 年的话：要关系到家里以外再没有别人，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和教室记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1950 年，先生一言不发地关系到家里以外再没有别人；教室里每一个学童都说这是头一回。（concerned nobody outside the family）
多年以后，先生仍来回两遍做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（concerns nobody outside the family）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯关系到家里以外再没有别人这件事本身。（to concern nobody outside the family）
早在 1944 年就有人关系到家里以外再没有别人，三月那天笔记簿上的一行字就是证据。（had concerned nobody outside the family）
先生说过，一言不发地关系到家里以外再没有别人这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（concerning nobody outside the family 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻使担心每一个听到消息的人，以后再也不要提起。（concern everybody who heard the news，祈使句）
answers: In 1950 the teacher concerned nobody outside the family in silence, and every pupil in the classroom said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three terms on, the teacher still concerns nobody outside the family twice over without being asked.
My mother said later that to concern nobody outside the family at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had concerned nobody outside the family long before 1957, and the line in the notebook for March proves it.
Concerning nobody outside the family in silence, the teacher said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Concern everybody who heard the news at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 concern 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1950 the teacher concerned nobody outside the family in silence, and nobody in the classroom forgot it.
Even now the teacher concerns nobody outside the family twice over whenever the classroom asks.
Concerning nobody outside the family in silence, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever concern everybody who heard the news twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new pupil from the next classroom concerns everybody who heard the news in silence every term, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother concerned nobody outside the family again, and the classroom remembered that half.
